HOW TO PLAY

Your first steps
into the dark.

New to the realm? Start here. Learn the essentials, then follow a topic when you want to go deeper.

THE ESSENTIALS

01 · Your character02 · Your first fight03 · Using magic04 · Finding your way05 · Meeting people06 · Playing together

01 / MAKE THE JOURNEY YOURS

Begin with
who you are.

Strength, Agility, Stamina, Vitality and Charisma shape your character’s strengths for the journey.

Choose a starting temperament across Witty, Empathetic and Bold. Your dialogue choices continue to develop it as you play. Personality describes how you respond; your moral choices describe where you stand.

Core Traits ↗Personality & dialogue ↗Character creation ↗

02 / STAY ALIVE LONG ENOUGH TO LEARN

Watch. Defend.
Find an opening.

A fight asks for more than a strong weapon. Keep an eye on your stamina and learn when to commit.

Block attacks coming from the front. Time a shield parry to turn a dangerous hit into a chance to counter. Dodge while moving to roll in that direction—and leave yourself enough stamina for what comes next. Learn your weapon’s strengths, signature technique and Ultimates.

Blocking ↗Shield parries ↗Dodge roll ↗Techniques & Ultimates ↗

03 / PUT POWER IN ITS PLACE

Deploy a Relief.
Enter its influence.

Reliefs bring Holy, Blood and Dark magic into the physical world.

Equip your school’s Relief and deploy it in front of you. Step into its growing influence to cast. You can use an available Relief of the same school, including a friend’s. Holy magic spends stamina. Blood magic asks for health as well as stamina. Dark magic adds Dark Points; reaching 100 brings permanent corruption.

Deploying a Relief ↗Costs & cooldowns ↗Understanding corruption ↗

04 / LEAVE THE FAMILIAR BEHIND

Look closer.
Remember the way.

New paths bring new opportunities—and new risks.

Explore to uncover the map. Discover Doll travel destinations to return to places you have visited. A locked door might need a key or a careful lockpicking attempt, and an item on a shelf may belong to someone. Carry a torch into the darkness and prepare before pushing farther.

Fast travel ↗The world map ↗Keys & lockpicking ↗Taking owned items ↗

05 / PEOPLE ARE PART OF THE WORLD

Earn trust.
Live with the response.

Your standing with one person is not the same as your reputation with a whole faction.

What you say and do can change relationships. Witnesses may remember a crime and react when they see you again. Get to know people individually; a shared title or family does not mean they all think alike.

Relationships ↗Faction reputation ↗Arrest & jail ↗

06 / BRING YOUR OWN STORY

Travel together.
Choose for yourself.

A campaign brings together up to four players, with up to two local players on each machine.

Join through a local network or a direct address. Everyone keeps their character and personal choices, while the host determines the physical outcome of shared scenes. Save together as a party. When an eligible teammate falls, a living companion has a brief chance to revive them.

Joining a game ↗Local co-op ↗Saving together ↗Reviving a friend ↗
